entry.name: mc.equals~
entry.digest: Is equal to, comparison of two signals  (multichannel)
entry.description: ==~ outputs a 1 signal when the left input is equal to the right input and a 0 when it is not equal to the right input. The right input can be a signal or a float.

arguments.name: initial-comparison-value
arguments.description: Sets an initial comparison value for the signal coming into the left inlet.is sent out if the signal is equal to the argument; otherwise,is sent out. If a signal is connected to the right inlet, the argument is ignored. If no argument is present, and no signal is connected to the right inlet, the initial value isby default.

attributes.name: fuzzy
attributes.digest: Fuzzy floating-point comparison epsilon
attributes.description: When non-zero, an epsilon value to use for fuzzy floating-point comparison. Note that this isn't an absolute tolerance value, but is scaled to accommodate relative error for very large and very small values. The wordcan be used to denote the systemvalue.When zero (default), standard floating-point comparison is used, which may cause apparently equal numbers to not be detected as such.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet: The signal is compared to a signal coming into the right inlet, or a constant value received in the right inlet. If it is equal to the value in the right inlet, 1 is sent out; otherwise, 0 is sent out.In right inlet: The signal is used for comparison with the signal coming into the left inlet.
